statement: systemd's pinned persistent ALSA udev rule applies to sound controlC nodes. It imports USB identity when needed, creates snd/by-id names from ID_BUS, ID_SERIAL and optional ID_USB_INTERFACE_NUM, and creates snd/by-path names from the path_id-derived ID_PATH or ID_PATH_WITH_USB_REVISION. This provides ALSA sound-card addressing and USB topology identity, but the rule does not pair an audio device with a separate HID or UHID controller.

applicability.scope: systemd rules.d/60-persistent-alsa.rules lines 3-15; file-level negative limited to this rule.
